about_short_description.short_description: Kaizen is a software that enables to instantly integrate into websites without APIs

product.name: Kaizen Browser Automation Platform
product.description: A cloud-based browser automation platform for integrating with websites and completing workflows without relying on APIs. Users define workflows in plain English and run them at scale across web applications.

product.name: Healthcare Workflow Automation
product.description: Browser automation for healthcare operations, including provider credentialing, payer enrollment, eligibility verification, prior authorization, claims-status monitoring, and related portal workflows.

product.name: Logistics Workflow Automation
product.description: Browser automation for logistics operations, including transportation-management-system integration, shipper and carrier portal work, and appointment scheduling across web-based systems.

product.name: Financial Services Workflow Automation
product.description: Browser automation for financial-services operations such as government data retrieval, tax filings, entity lookups, and suspicious-activity-report submission.

product.name: Cross-Industry Portal Automation Services
product.description: Custom browser automation for web-based workflows in industries such as hospitality, insurance, and procurement, including booking, quoting, vendor onboarding, purchasing, and invoicing.
